name: Ben Berk
office: Antelope Valley Joint Union High School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Ben Berk is a candidate for the Antelope Valley Joint Union High School District Governing Board, Trustee Area 1. His ballot designation is Father/Business Owner, and his professional background is in finance. Berk served in the U.S. Navy from 2005 to 2010 and in the U.S. Army from 2010 to 2020. He serves as the financial officer for Vets4Veterans and was appointed to the Lancaster Planning Commission in August 2025.
